body:
When I navigate to the configuration page of the documentation => https://starship.rs/config/
The first example of config option I see is `add_newline`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/702227/106982466-13b1be80-675c-11eb-8227-be75c2958327.png)

Because I care more about having my prompt on the same line than having a new line after my command output, I tend to guess that this is the option I am looking for.

Plus, the comment above the option is not clear because it is a negation. By `Don't print a new line at the start of the prompt` => I personally did not get what that meant without your comment on this very issue. What I understand from this is that my prompt by default is starting on the second line, thus turning this `add_newline` to true will put everything on the same line.

Under the prompt section, it is written that when `add_newline` is true, it `Add a new line before the start of the prompt`. This sentence is limpid, I think it is easier to understand in this direction because there is no negation in the sentence.

My humble suggestions:
- on the first config example, remove the first 2 lines (I believe that anyway this parameter should be under the prompt module?)
- under the Prompt section, replace the negation in the comment above the `add_newline` by a simpler sentence
